title: Nanorix AuditProof v2.1
description: JSON Schema for the Nanorix AuditProof document — the cryptographically signed, ephemeral capsule destruction record. Two physical shapes are described: VerificationCdp (shareable, public-facing, the auditor moment-of-truth artifact) and FullCdp (operational record, customer-only). Both shapes share the 8-step SHA-512 hash chain anchor and Ed25519 attestation envelope; FullCdp carries the activity trail and reserved attestation slots. This schema covers cdp_version 2.1 — the current Forever-Standard surface. Future minor-bump versions will add Optional fields per ADR-006 I0; existing shape is permanent. Schema scaffold ships with the verifier crate; the published copy at schema.nanorix.com is release-event-gated.

VerificationCdp.title: AuditProof — the shareable projection
VerificationCdp.description: Public-facing AuditProof projection. Contains zero operational details — no filenames, no commands, no capsulefile metadata. Auditor moment-of-truth artifact. AuditProof = VerificationCdp; AuditRecord = FullCdp (per ADR-014 external-brand split).

cdp_version.description: AuditProof schema version. Pinned at "2.1" for current Forever-Standard surface. Future minor-bumps add Optional fields per ADR-006 I0; existing variants permanent.

capsule_id.description: Capsule identifier, lowercase-hex 32-char suffix. Stable across destroy.

signing_key_version.description: Identifies which signing key version produced this AuditProof. Resolved against the trust-chain manifest at the auditor's machine. Values like "local-ephemeral" (dev/test), KMS version number (production), or "none" (unsigned partial).

document_hash.description: SHA-512 hex of the canonical AuditRecord document — the value Ed25519-signed. Enables independent signature verification without the full record. The optional "sha512:" prefix is the canonical wire form; verifiers strip the prefix before hex compare.

verify.description: Human-readable verification hint string — usually a URL where an auditor can verify the AuditProof in a browser. Not cryptographically bound; advisory only.

parent_audit_proof_id.description: Customer-declared parent AuditProof reference for multi-step pipeline composition. Optional and additive per Forever-Standard discipline; absent OR null = pipeline-genesis capsule. Verifier chain-walk validates parent reachability + same-org_id binding + per-link signature; semantic truthfulness of the linkage is customer-declared (Nanorix does not validate).

oneOf.description: Customer-defined business context. Open key-value space. Customer-declared vocabulary; Nanorix prescribes no structured keys. 4 KB total size limit. Reserved prefix "nanorix:*" forbidden for customer keys.

metadata.description: Open metadata bag. Optional; absent or null in AuditProofs without customer-declared business context.

FullCdp.title: AuditRecord — the full operational document
FullCdp.description: Customer-only operational record. Carries activity trail, reserved attestation slots, destruction outcome, residency, and 8-step chain. Internal struct name `FullCdp`; external brand `AuditRecord` per ADR-014 naming split.

activity.description: Customer-declared activity trail. Variant-additive Forever-Standard taxonomy per ADR-006 I0.

chain.description: Eight-step destruction hash chain. Step count is exactly 8 (Forever-Standard); structural mismatch produces step_count_invalid failure.

final_hash.description: SHA-512 hex matching the last chain step's chain_hash. The optional "sha512:" prefix is the canonical wire form.

destroyed_at.description: The timestamp every chain step hashes (ADR-047). A verifier recomputes each step as SHA-512(prev || 0x00 || subsystem || 0x00 || method || 0x00 || timestamp) and cannot walk the chain without it. Not canonical-hash-bound: adding it does not alter the signed bytes, so proofs issued before it was declared remain valid signatures — they are simply not independently chain-verifiable.

destruction_trigger.description: Free-form why-the-destroy. Current values: "user_explicit" (DELETE /v1/capsules/:id), "server_restart" (recovery), reserved future variants. Not canonical-hash-bound.

attestation.description: Primary Ed25519 attestation from Nanorix signing authority (or customer authority under ADR-031 dual-signing). Null on unsigned partial AuditRecords.

signing_mode.description: Authority signing-mode. Canonical-hash-bound — included in canonical view per ADR-011 Part 3 to prevent dual-signature downgrade attack (ADR-011 I22).

jurisdiction.description: Customer-declared jurisdiction. Filters which regulatory frameworks the AuditRecord references.

authority_id.description: Signing authority identifier resolved against the trust-chain manifest. Values like "us-kms-nanorix-v1", "eu-kms-nanorix-v1", "customer-hsm-<customer-slug>-v<n>".

org_id.description: Capsule's owning org. Snapshotted at destroy time. Load-bearing for cross-customer parent-chain attack closure during verifier chain-walk.

runtime_attestation.description: Hardware-rooted runtime attestation slot. Reserved; null in current shape; future TEE/SGX integration.

timestamp_attestation.description: RFC 3161 trusted-timestamp attestation slot. Reserved; null in current shape.

attestation_chain_fingerprint.description: SHA-512 fingerprint of the authority attestation chain document. Empty string until an authority attestation chain is issued.

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm pin. Locked to SHA-512 in current shape.

signature_algorithm.description: Signature algorithm pin. Locked to Ed25519 in current shape; future PQC variants require schema minor-bump.

customer_attestation.description: Customer-attested signature slot for dual-signature signing-mode. Null when signing-mode is "nanorix_only".

per_event_attestations.description: Per-event customer attestations slot. Reserved per ADR-007 A8 + ADR-012 D3; null in current shape.

pqc_attestation.description: Reserved post-quantum signature slot. Null in current shape; future PQC migration.

destruction_state.description: Terminal destruction outcome. Canonical-hash-bound; single character drift invalidates every AuditRecord.

destruction_failure_step.description: Step number 1..8 when destruction_state is "incomplete_destruction"; null for "complete" and "aborted". Canonical-hash-bound.

sealed.description: True when the capsule ran with no outbound network. False when an egress profile permitted outbound traffic.

encryption.description: Encryption posture description. Free-form; current values reflect the at-rest + in-transit envelope.

network.description: Network posture description. Values like "sealed" (no outbound), "egress-filtered" (allowlist), or named profile.

content_hash.description: Aggregate content hash over all files. Empty string permitted when file_count is 0.

started.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the capsule was created.

destroyed.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the capsule was destroyed.

chain.description: Chain summary — typically a count or pretty-printed step list. Advisory; not canonical-hash-bound.

subsystem.description: Subsystem label. Forever-Standard; the eight subsystem strings are immutable per ADR-006 I0.

public_key.description: Public key bytes, base64. Optional "base64:" prefix is the canonical wire form.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical hex-string of the document hash. Base64. Optional "base64:" prefix is the canonical wire form.

ActivityEvent.description: Customer-declared activity event. Variant-additive Forever-Standard taxonomy with serde tag dispatch (key "type", snake_case values). Open shape — concrete variants are documented in the verifier crate; auditor tooling treats unknown variants as "needs follow-up" rather than rejecting the AuditRecord.
